newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sullivan Dental rating cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sullivan Dental rating cut.

text.p: -- Mesirow Financial Inc said Wednesday it cut its rating on Sullivan Dental Products Inc to buy from focus list buy because of the substantial appreciation in the shares since its initial recommendation in October.
-- Mesirow said its intermediate price objective of $15-$16 a share has been reached. Its 12-month target remains $18.
-- Sales and earnings momentum remain strong in the first two months of the first quarter, Mesirow said.
-- Mesirow said acquisition activity in the distribution industry may have contributed to the increase in trading activity for Sullivan shares.
-- Sullivan markets dental supplies and equipment.
-- Its shares were trading off 3/8 Wednesday at 15-1/4.
